name: Sage
description: Cool paper, botanical sage, green charcoal.
tradeoff: Calm and familiar; the most visibly green overall.

name: Oat & Olive
description: Warm paper, olive accents, soft charcoal.
tradeoff: Warmer and more book-like; less crisp and cool.

name: Clay
description: Warm porcelain, terracotta, deep brown charcoal.
tradeoff: Personal and earthy; stronger accent presence.

name: Plum
description: Pale mineral paper, muted plum, aubergine charcoal.
tradeoff: Distinctive and quieter than a bright purple; a cooler, more designed mood.
